claim_text: A major drought and a very hot summer warned for Australia, set inside a standing pattern of extreme drought in one place and flooding rain in another, which he attributes to weather manipulation.
quote: it would be so dry and so drought in one place
falsify_match: An Australian summer of record heat and drought in 2025-26.
falsify_miss: An ordinary or wet Australian summer. Base rate: drought in one region and flooding in another is the normal state of the Australian continent in any given year, which is what makes the paired form untestable.
